the following two aspects.
the design of an online algorithm that minimizes the energy consumption while guaranteeing delay performance.
a fundamental question: How to schedule cloud offloading and cloud execution output download to minimize the average power consumption while guaranteeing a bounded average queue length?

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have proposed an online algorithm for cloud offloading and download scheduling in a multi-application multi-core mobile device and proved its performance bound with respect to average delay and average power consumption.
we propose a novel cloud offloading scheme with performance bounds and reveal an energy-delay trade-off for cloud offloading.

, for multi-core devices, cloud offloading can significantly improve energy efficiency and delay performance of mobile devices, and that the performance gain is more pronounced when the number of applications increases.

the energy delay trade-off can be characterized in a closed-form expression and that there exists a threshold value of the delay constraint that separates the energy-delay optimal region from the energy-optimal region.
